comment.el:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Η τροπολογία 5 ακυρώνεται.
Η Ομάδα PPE αποσύρει τις τροπολογίες 31 και 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendment 5 had been cancelled.
The PPE Group had withdrawn Amendments 31 and 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Verschiedenes</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Änderungsantrag 5 wurde annulliert.
Die PPE-Fraktion hat die Änderungsanträge 31 und 32 zurückgezogen.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Įvairūs</title><remarkFreeText><translation>5a pakeitimas buvo panaikintas.
PPE frakcija atsiėmė pasiūlymą dėl 31 ir 32 pakeitimo.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 5 foi anulada.
O grupo PPE retirou as alterações 31 e 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Iné</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 5 bol zrušený.
Skupina PPE stiahla PN 31 a 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 5 ha sido anulada.
El Grupo PPE ha retirado las enmiendas 31 y 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.mt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varji</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L-emenda 345 ġiet annullata.
Il-Grupp PPE irtira l-emendi 31 u 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 5 var blevet annulleret.
    PPE-Gruppen havde trukket ændringsforslag 31 og 32 tilbage.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh Leasú 5 a chealú.
Rinne an Grúpa PPE na leasuithe 31 agus 32 a tharraingt siar.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hu:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Egyéb</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A 5 a. módosítást törölték.
A PPE képviselőcsoport visszavonta a 31. és 32. sz. módosításokat.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 5 a fost anulat.
Grupul PPE a retras amendamentele 31 și 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversen</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 5 is geannuleerd.
De PPE‑Fractie heeft de amendementen 31 en 32 ingetrokken.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Разни</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменение 5 беше анулирано.
Групата PPE оттегли изменения 31 и 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 5 bija atcelts.
PPE grupa bija atsaukusi grozījumus Nr. 31 un Nr. 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Övriga frågor</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslag 5 hade strukits.
PPE-gruppen drog tillbaka sitt stöd för ändringsförslag 31 och 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amandman 5 je poništen.
Klub zastupnika PPE-a povukao je amandmane 31. i 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'amendement 5 a été annulé.
Le groupe PPE a retiré les amendements 31 et 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.et:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Muud küsimused</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Muudatusettepanek 5 tühistati.
Fraktsioon PPE võttis tagasi muudatusettepanekud 31 ja 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Pn. 5 byl zrušen.
Skupina PPE vzala zpět pn. 31 a 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'emendamento 5 è stato annullato.
Il gruppo PPE ha ritirato gli emendamenti 31 e 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Różne</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Poprawkę 5 anulowano.
Grupa PPE wycofała poprawki 31 i 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl:
<remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 5 je bil razveljavljen.
Skupina PPE je umaknila predloga sprememb 31 in 32.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
